rows.name: Healing Touch I
rows.class_row_html: 14 Healing Touch I 108 2.5 30 Heals your defensive target for 461.
rows.detail_main_html:
Healing Touch I

Paladin · Level 14

Effect

Heals your defensive target for 461.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

The Cleric has a Healing Touch of its own, and it is a different ability rather than the same one shared. Compared at matching levels the Cleric's heals for more every time -- 23% more at rank I, narrowing to 10% by rank V -- which fits the Paladin being the heavier-armoured, lesser-healing half of the pair.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.

Shield of Resolve

Paladin · Level 38

Effect

Imbues your shield with a chance to restore your group's endurance when hit or with shield attacks (only allowed one shield consecration at a time)

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

Level in 2007-2008
38
Consecrates your shield, imbuing it with the power of resolve. Incoming attacks have a chance of restoring your endurance. Shield attacks also gain a small chance to restore the endurance of an ally. Only one shield consecration may be active at a time.

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Notes

Confirmed present in the VGO Emulator client: it appears in the Paladin's Adventuring spellbook, captured in full (201 entries over 9 pages) on a level 50 character. The tooltip has not been read, so the figures below still come from the source credited above.
